product.title: Best of Barcelona Guided Tour with Port or Hotel Pick up

description.text: Discover the best of Barcelona with ease—even if you just have half a day to spare—on this comprehensive, small-group tour. With a guide to lead the way as well as hotel or port pickup provided, you can avoid any hassle and maximize your sightseeing time. Stops include Sagrada Familia, Park Güell, Gothic Quarter. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so visitors can focus on Gaudí architecture, Mediterranean views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
